description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of the number of tweets across discrete category values from 0 to 5. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 in ascending order, with no explicit axis title shown; the vertical axis is labeled “Number of tweets” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 up to roughly 470,000, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 100,000 intervals. There are visible bars at categories 0 through 4, with category 5 showing no visible bar (approximately 0). The bar at category 1 (tan/orange) is the tallest at about 465,000 tweets, category 2 (green) is slightly shorter at about 410,000, category 3 (red) is around 95,000, and categories 0 (blue) and 4 (purple) are very small, each on the order of only a few thousand tweets. The bars are single (not grouped or stacked), appear uniformly styled without annotations or outlines, and are not sorted by height beyond the natural numeric ordering of the category labels.
